title: Non-lucrative residence visa for people living on their own means without working

sources.title: Real Decreto 1155/2024 (foreigners regulation), article 62.1 and 62.2: 400% of the monthly IPREM for the applicant plus 100% per family member in their charge, for the validity of the permit
Real Decreto 1155/2024, article 61.1 and 61.2 a): residence without work or professional activity, on means that cover living costs with no need for any such activity
Real Decreto 1155/2024, article 61.3 a): the spouse, registered partner or duly proven stable partner; a year of living together, or children in common with stable cohabitation, proves the bond
Real Decreto 1155/2024, article 61.3 b) and c): unmarried minor children, and adult children with a disability that needs support or unable to provide for themselves for health reasons
Real Decreto 1155/2024, article 61.2 b): the applicant must have health insurance
Real Decreto 1155/2024, article 61.2 c): not within a period of commitment not to return to Spain taken on when returning voluntarily to the country of origin
Real Decreto 1155/2024, articles 61.2 d) and 63.3: no threat to public order, security or health, checked through criminal records in Spain and a police report, which alone does not refuse the permit
Real Decreto 1155/2024, article 38 b): a residence visa requires not being irregularly in Spanish territory
Real Decreto 1155/2024, article 38 c): a residence visa requires not being listed as refusable in the territory of countries with which Spain has an agreement to that effect
Real Decreto 1155/2024, article 38 d): a passport or travel document in force, recognized as valid in Spain, valid for at least one year
Real Decreto 1155/2024, article 38 e): an applicant of criminal majority age has no criminal record, in the countries lived in during the last five years, for offences under Spanish law
Real Decreto 1155/2024, article 38 i): a medical certificate that the applicant has none of the diseases with serious public health effects under the International Health Regulations of 2005
Real Decreto 1155/2024, article 61.4: the initial non-lucrative temporary residence permit lasts one year
Real Decreto 1155/2024, article 64.7: the renewed permit is valid for two years, unless a long-term residence permit is due
Real Decreto 1155/2024, article 63.4: the permit is decided within one month from the consulate's communication; with no answer in that time the application is taken as refused
Real Decreto 1155/2024, article 39.5: the consulate decides and issues the visa within one month from receiving the favourable decision on the permit
Real Decreto 1155/2024, article 63.5: within one month of entering Spain the holder applies in person for the foreigner identity card
Ley 31/2022 (State Budget for 2023), additional provision 90: monthly IPREM of EUR 600; the 2023 budget stays extended and no later law or decree in the BOE sets another amount (searched 2026-11-11)
Orden EFD/581/2026, whose title states that the 2023 State Budget (Ley 31/2022) stays extended for 2024, 2025 and 2026
Código Civil, article 5.1: a period in years with no matching day in its last month ends on that month's last day; article 240: majority at 18
Código Penal (Ley Orgánica 10/1995), article 19: people under 18 are not criminally responsible under the code
Ley Orgánica 4/2000, article 1: Spanish nationals are not foreigners under this law, and EU citizens and others under the EU regime follow that regime's rules
Real Decreto 240/2007, article 1 and third additional provision: residence in Spain of citizens of other EU and EEA states, and of Swiss citizens
Ley Orgánica 4/2000, articles 44.2, 46.1 and 48.1: fees for processing residence permits, identity cards and visas, owed by each applicant or holder, in amounts set by ministerial order
Ley Orgánica 4/2000, article 48.4: visa fees follow the amount that may be set by applying the principle of reciprocity
Orden AUC/891/2024, article 1: EUR 90 for processing a national long-stay visa (type D) application, for every application from one month after its publication on 2024-08-24
Orden PJC/617/2025, in force from 2025-06-16, annex, fee 2.1.1: EUR 10.94 for the initial non-lucrative temporary residence permit, for the principal holder and for family members
Orden PJC/617/2025, in force from 2025-06-16, annex, fee 4.2: EUR 16.08 for the foreigner identity card that documents the first grant of a temporary residence permit

requirements.title: A year of passive income plus liquid assets of 400% of the IPREM (Spain's income index, EUR 600) a month for the principal, plus 100% per dependent: EUR 2,400 and EUR 600
Not a citizen of an EU or EEA state or of Switzerland, Spain included: they live in Spain under EU free movement rules, not this visa

assessments.title: Living in Spain without any work or professional activity: the permit does not allow it, and the means must cover living costs with no need for it
Not within a period of commitment not to return to Spain, taken on when returning voluntarily to the country of origin
No threat to public order, public security or public health: Spain checks its own criminal records and a police report; a police record alone does not refuse the permit
Aged 18 or over: no criminal record, in the countries lived in during the last five years, for offences that Spanish law also punishes
Not listed as refusable in the territory of countries with which Spain has an agreement to that effect
A passport or travel document in force, recognized as valid in Spain, valid for at least one year
A medical certificate showing none of the diseases with serious public health effects under the International Health Regulations of 2005

dependents.title: Partner of at least one year (a registered partner, or one with children in common, is shown as possible)
Children: unmarried and under 18, or adults who need support for a disability or cannot provide for themselves (adults: possible, the case does not record this)
The spouse's children: unmarried and under 18, or adults who need support for a disability or cannot provide for themselves (adults: possible, the case does not record this)
The qualifying partner's children: unmarried and under 18, or adults who need support for a disability or cannot provide for themselves (adults: possible, the case does not record this)

costs.title: Fee for processing the principal's national long-stay visa application; another amount may apply by reciprocity with the applicant's country, which is not checked
Fee for processing each family member's national long-stay visa application; another amount may apply by reciprocity with the applicant's country, which is not checked
Fee for processing the principal's initial non-lucrative temporary residence permit
Fee for processing each family member's initial non-lucrative temporary residence permit
Fee for the principal's foreigner identity card (TIE), applied for in person within one month of entering Spain
Fee for each family member's foreigner identity card (TIE), applied for in person within one month of entering Spain

durations.title: Decision on the residence permit, counted from the consulate's communication to the foreigners office; with no answer within one month the application is taken as refused
Decision and issue of the visa by the consulate, counted from its receipt of the favourable decision on the permit
Application in person for the foreigner identity card (TIE), counted from the entry into Spain
Each renewed permit, unless a long-term residence permit is due
